answer_1.quote: We focus on generative commonsense reasoning, or CommonGen, which involves generating logical sentences describing an everyday scenario from a set of concepts ...

answer_2.quote: We use a gamut of automatic evaluation metrics. These include those used by, such as BLEU, CIDEr, SPICE, and Coverage (Cov). We also introduce BERTScore ... For all metrics, higher corresponds to better performance.

answer_4.quote: We ask annotators to evaluate 48 test CG examples ... The annotators evaluate fluency and commonsense of the texts on 1-5 scales.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated sentence on fluency (naturalness) and commonsense (plausibility) using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
